scope: Controlled WaterColor RTV1 public-API repeat-32 profile. Native GL output is stored as lower-left readback; sparse final oracle is vertically normalized to the top-left SVG/resvg frame.

source.phase_state: seed 0.0; source PHASE_STEP/TAU float32 recurrence continues across all 480 public AddPoint records; sincosf is recomputed using the existing bounded host profile. Base-sampled x/y/width/alpha lanes repeat bytewise every 15 rows.
source.profile_scope: Controlled native WaterColor RTV1 public-API profile. A pinned natural Drawing ObjectStroke capture supplies the original 15 AddPoint tuples and source ARGB/size provenance; selected ARGB overrides are passed only to PenDrawableRT::SetPenData, and the density profile repeats those exact tuples through public RTV1::AddPoint. Repeated-input profiles are controlled RT API tests, not Drawing-owned strokes. RTV1 Init/CreatePenCanvas/AddPoint/Update/Draw, inherited RT buffer APIs, native Graphics output bitmap/CanvasImpl path, embedded mask/composite shader, Renderer, and passive MXCSR observation execute. Mesa GLES is host output; no device parity claim.
source.public_repeat_semantics: the complete 15-tuple pinned natural Drawing sequence replayed in order for every repeat; no coordinate/radius/alpha edits

material.source_color_getter: Reuse baseline native fixture ARGB through existing input_color() PenCommon/getColor FMA helper; do not duplicate color constants.
material.final_frame_row_order: top-left (native GL readback is vertically flipped before sparse encoding)

native_final_sparse.record_format: u16le top-left row-major pixel index, then RGBA8; all unspecified pixels are exact transparent zero.

high_branch_mask_invariant.record_format: u16le top-left row-major native mask pixel index, then mask R,G bytes
high_branch_mask_invariant.assertion: every observed native mask pixel with G>=179 has R=255; source high-branch G-only lookup is admitted only after this assertion passes.
high_branch_mask_invariant.coordinate_origin: top-left after flipping native GL lower-left readback rows

render_profile.material_quantization: source shader equations plus captured RNE host profile; no native output pixels select LUT entries.
render_profile.mask_blend: per-instance RGBA8 additive GL_FUNC_ADD; SVG k1=0,k2=1,k3=1,k4=0.
render_profile.final_blend: GL_FUNC_ADD with GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA.
render_profile.high_branch_rounding_boundary: Fragment-worker MXCSR was not captured; RNE half arithmetic is a named host candidate, not universal native behavior.
